subject: CloudCon 2028 — final load-in phasing & graphics order
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: AtlasExhibits <ops@atlasexhibits.com>, Grace Henderson <grace@cloudcon.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CloudCon 2028 — initial load-in plan & graphics order

Hi all,

We're locking the final load-in phasing for Redwood's 20x20 island at CloudCon next month. Primary items we need to confirm this week:

- Load-in window(s) and door access (swing/rollup) for our crate sizes (two crates, 96x48x48 each)
- Dock time slot and forklift availability
- Graphics dielines/timing for press (we're on a 5-business-day print turn)
- Electrical drop location and stage power specs (we plan for 2x20A circuits + one 30A)

Attached: CLOUDCON_Loadin_Window_20280821.pdf (proposed windows), plus our current graphics files on Drive.

Grace — can you confirm the dock windows and whether Dock 5 supports simultaneous forklift ops?

Atlas — please review the phasing and confirm you can get the crates through the swing gate (we were told gate clearance is 10ft) and send ETA for the rigging crew.

I'll coordinate final signage proofs once Marissa shares dielines.

Thanks,
Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Field Marketing Lead | Redwood Inference
Cell: +1 (415) 555-0184

Attachments: CLOUDCON_Loadin_Window_20280821.pdf

From: AtlasExhibits <ops@atlasexhibits.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Atlas Freight <freight@atlasexhibits.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudCon 2028 — initial load-in plan & graphics order

Rafael —

Thanks for the details. Quick answers:

- Gate clearance: confirmed 10' swing gate is fine for those crate dims, but the aisle under door header is 9'8" on a few passes — we recommend offloading at Dock 5 and using our carting path to the booth to avoid squeeze points.
- Forklift: Atlas Freight will supply a 5,000 lb forklift during your booked window (we'll confirm operator license on Thursday).
- Rigging crew ETA: we can allocate a 3-person crew for your build on day 1 of move-in; they typically start immediately after dock clearance (estimate +45 minutes).
- Electrical: we can pull power to the center of the island but need a floor plan showing final monitor and kiosk placement.

I'll attach a short rigging checklist and a proposed move sequence. Do you have final graphics dielines? Vector files make on-site last-minute edits harder, so please supply clean PDFs with bleed if possible.

Best,
Claire Ramos
Operations Manager, Atlas Exhibits
ops@atlasexhibits.com
Attachment: atlas_rigging_checklist.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>, AtlasExhibits <ops@atlasexhibits.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 14:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudCon 2028 — initial load-in plan & graphics order

Thanks Claire —

Attached is the latest graphics package (RI-booth-graphics-v3.ai stored on Drive). Important changes since v2: larger tagline on backwall (+1.5" tracking), swapped the left monitor for a QR-code panel, and added a vinyl step decal for the demo area.

Priyom — need confirmation on the QR panel print: is 100% matte laminate fine? Also, the dielines expect a 2" bleed; Atlas, please confirm you can handle bleeds at print.

Rafael — I'll export clean PDFs by EOD for the print house if Priyom approves the laminate.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Events Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: RI-booth-graphics-v3.ai (source on Drive)

From: Grace Henderson <grace@cloudcon.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, AtlasExhibits <ops@atlasexhibits.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 09:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: CloudCon 2028 — final load-in phasing & graphics order

Forwarding internal logistics note: Rafael — Dock 5 is available in the morning window you requested (Mon move-in, 07:00-11:00 PT). Gate procedures:

"On Wed, 22 Aug 2028 at 08:43 CloudCon Logistics <logistics@cloudcon.com> wrote:
> Rafael,
>
> Dock 5 supports simultaneous forklift ops but we cap active forklifts at two during peak windows for safety. Carting path is clear; however, there will be an AV pre-wire crew moving cables from 06:45 which may constrain aisle width.
>
> Please ensure your crate labeling matches the attached arrival manifest and that the Atlas team stages crates at the marked holding area if they arrive before 07:00.
>
> Grace Henderson
> Exhibitor Services Manager
>CloudCon Logistics
>Attachment: arrival_manifest_cloudcon_20280822.pdf

Grace

PS — we've added a temporary swing gate easing window for crates wider than 48"; please note the gate latch opens on the right. I'll place a signage restriction note in the exhibitor portal.

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, AtlasExhibits <ops@atlasexhibits.com>, Grace Henderson <grace@cloudcon.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudCon 2028 — final load-in phasing & graphics order

Great — thanks everyone. Quick summary of agreed actions (so we have a single source of truth):

1) Dock/Timing: CloudCon confirmed Dock 5 slot Mon 07:00-11:00 PT; Atlas to arrive at 06:30 for staging at holding area. (Grace: arrival_manifest_cloudcon_20280822.pdf)
2) Forklift/Rigging: Atlas Freight to provide forklift + 3-person crew; cap of 2 active forklifts during peak. (Atlas to confirm operator license by Thurs)
3) Graphics: Marissa to export final PDFs with 2" bleed by EOD today; Priyom to confirm matte laminate approval by 17:00 PT. We will send files to the printer (5 business day turnaround).
4) Electrical: Atlas needs final monitor/kiosk placement; Priyom to share wiring plan. I've attached the power diagram (power_wiring_diagram_v2.pdf) for reference.
5) On-site: Grace will place a right-latch swing-gate note in the portal and block the AV pre-wire crew path from 06:45-07:15.

Next steps: Priyom — please reply-all with final wiring plan and laminate signoff. Atlas — confirm operator license and crew ETA. Marissa — attach the PDF proofs to the Drive link and CC me.

I'll convert this thread into a single checklist and post into the CloudCon shared folder.

Thanks,
Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Field Marketing Lead | Redwood Inference

Attachments: power_wiring_diagram_v2.pdf
